nodes.label: Mobile Bottom Navigation / Footer (footer_tmpl)
nodes.rationale: footer_tmpl is the shopfront closing block: a fixed d-lg-none mobile bottom bar (home, account, cart, orders, cart offcanvas via data-bs-toggle), a full footer with service icons, widget menus, newsletter form and trust seals, plus a scroll-progress 'go to top' widget. It uses Bootstrap 5 offcanvas data attributes, unlike the Bootstrap 4 + AdminLTE admin stack, so the two shells are on different Bootstrap majors.
